title: Cosmic Turtle and Cobra
description: A detailed surreal painting shows a large ornate sea turtle wearing a golden crown floating through a starry night sky. Below it, a spectral cobra with orange markings rises from swirling dark smoke beside a giant glowing pink-capped mushroom with white spots, all surrounded by a vibrant field of pink, purple, and white cosmos flowers.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene featuring a large detailed sea turtle with glowing golden shell patterns and a pink crown floating in a starry night sky with purple and blue nebulae. A spectral cobra with orange markings emerges from dark swirling smoke beside a giant bioluminescent pink mushroom with white spots. The foreground is filled with a dense field of pink, purple, and white cosmos flowers under a cosmic twilight sky with shooting stars.
